This indicates that Phenethyl Propionate may influence WI-38 through the action of 8-P-Menthene-1,2-diol, (+)-, which then affects Thrombopoietin. The integration of these pathways suggests a potential role for Phenethyl Propionate in modulating the expression or activity of Thrombopoietin, possibly through a signaling cascade involving the 8-P-Menthene-1,2-diol, (+)- pathway. The evidence supports a mechanistic link, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated.
